2607.25716.title: SpeechLLM Meets Federated Learning for End-to-End ASR: English and Italian Case Studies
2607.25716.paper_summary: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving training of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems across distributed data sources, yet its application to large-scale speech language models (SpeechLLMs) remains unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of federated training for SpeechLLM-based end-to-end ASR systems. We design a communication-efficient federated optimization strategy tailored to the unique challenges of SpeechLLM architectures, addressing high-dimensional parameter spaces, gradient communication overhead, and computational constraints in distributed settings. Through extensive empirical evaluation on monolingual ASR tasks in English and Italian, we demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of our federated approach compared to centralized training baselines across diverse acoustic conditions and speaking styles. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study analyzing the impact of different speech encoder architectures on monolingual English ASR performance within the federated framework, providing insights into optimal model configurations for decentralized training. Our results achieve competitive word error rates while reducing communication costs, establishing practical foundations for federated SpeechLLM deployment in real-world multilingual scenarios.
2607.25716.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習 (FL) 使得在分散數據源中進行自動語音識別 (ASR) 系統的隱私保護訓練成為可能，但其在大規模語音語言模型 (SpeechLLMs) 中的應用尚未被探索。本文首次系統性地研究了基於 SpeechLLM 的端到端 ASR 系統的聯邦訓練。我們設計了一種針對 SpeechLLM 架構獨特挑戰的通信高效聯邦優化策略，解決了高維參數空間、梯度通信開銷和分散環境中的計算限制。通過在英語和意大利語的單語 ASR 任務上進行廣泛的實證評估，我們展示了我們的聯邦方法在各種聲學條件和說話風格下，相較於集中訓練基準的有效性和穩定性。此外，我們進行了一項全面的消融研究，分析了不同語音編碼器架構在聯邦框架內對單語英語 ASR 性能的影響，提供了有關去中心化訓練的最佳模型配置的見解。我們的結果在降低通信成本的同時實現了具有競爭力的字錯誤率，為在現實世界多語言場景中部署聯邦 SpeechLLM 建立了實際基礎。
